content: Docker Publish builds docker/production/Dockerfile, which copies the same root entrypoint.sh used by the shared Dockerfile. Startup regression tests must execute that shell script and prove failed Prisma preparation never launches the app, while successful preparation preserves command arguments and exit status.

GoogleTaskProvider normalizes API notes/due/completed into description/dueDate/completedDate. GoogleFieldMapper consumes that normalized interface, not raw wire fields. Check completion timestamps all the way through sync-manager create and update payloads; mapper-only tests miss dropped creation fields. Keep existing canonical dueDate behavior and local startDate semantics when correcting contradictory legacy tests.
